conditional_method_evidence: pq_split on exposed Jena development data
reason: Jena shows lower MSE than prior LEVEL and matched RAW64, so the P/Q correction remains a conditional methodological observation. Robin does not establish an improvement over prior LEVEL; the point estimate is worse and its block interval crosses zero. The approved new cost grid is Robin-only. Repeating that grid would not change the Robin configuration decision and would not establish a Jena accuracy-cost tradeoff. Consequently no new deployment configuration is adopted and the conditional Robin benchmark is omitted. This is not a claim that the correction has no value anywhere.
limits: No new latency, throughput, peak inference memory or Pareto superiority is claimed. Prior timing is not divided by a new timing. Jena costs are unmeasured.
